Board Diversity Policy                                                           董事會成員多元化政策
The Board has adopted the following board diversity policy (the                  董事會已採納以下董事會成員多元化政策（「董事
“Board Diversity Policy”).                                                       會成員多元化政策」）。


Background and Vision                                                            背景與願景

Respect for people and diversity is one of the Company’s core                    以人為本及多元化是本公司的核心價值之一。本
value. The Company recognises and embraces the benefits of                       公司明白並深信董事會成員多元化對提升公司表
having a diverse Board to enhance the quality of its performance.                現裨益良多。


Policy Statement                                                                 政策聲明

The Company believes that board diversity enhances                               本公司相信董事會成員多元化能提高決策能力，
decision-making capability and a diverse board is more effective in              而且一個多元化的董事會能更有效地處理組織的
dealing with organisational changes and less likely to suffer from               變化，並可較少受到群體思維的壓力。為達致可
group thinking. With a view to achieving a sustainable and balanced              持續及均衡的發展，本公司視提升董事會層面的
development, the Company sees increasing diversity at the Board                  多元化為支持其達到戰略目標及其可持續發展的
level as an essential element in supporting the attainment of its                關鍵元素。
strategic objectives and its sustainable development.

to gender, age, cultural and educational background, ethnicity,                  化 及 教 育 背 景、 種 族、 專 業 經 驗、 營 商 視 野、

and length of service, and any other factors that the Board may                  關及適用的任何其他因素，並著重於確保董事會
consider relevant and applicable from time to time. High emphasis is             成員的技能及經驗組合均衡分佈，以提供不同觀
placed on ensuring a balanced composition of skills and experience               點、見解和提問，讓董事會可以有效地履行其職
at the Board level in order to provide a range of perspectives,                  務 及 職 責、 就 本 集 團 的 核 心 業 務 及 策 略 制 定 良

and responsibilities effectively, support good decision making in

 Sunny Optical Technology (Group) Company Limited (the                 舜宇光學科技（集團）有限公司（「本公司」）

 September 2006 as an exempted company under the Companies             開曼群島公司法第21章（一九六一年第三條
 Law Chapter 21 (Law 3 of 1961 as consolidated and revised) of         法例，經綜合及修訂）註冊成立為獲豁免公
 the Cayman Islands and its shares have been listed on the Stock       司，其股份自二零零七年六月十五日起在香
 Exchange of Hong Kong Limited with effect from 15 June 2007. Its      港聯合交易所有限公司上市，最終控股及母
 ultimate holding and parent company is Sun Xu Limited, a private      公司為一間於英屬處女群島註冊成立的私人
 limited company incorporated in the British Virgin Islands. Its       有限公司舜旭有限公司，而最終控股人士為
 ultimate controlling party is Mr. Wang Wenjian, also a director of    王文鑒先生，亦為本公司董事。本公司註冊
 the Company. The addresses of the registered office and principal     辦事處及主要營業地點的地址乃於年報公司
 place of business of the Company are disclosed in the Corporate       資料一節披露。
 Information section of the annual report.


 The Company is an investment holding company. The Company             本公司為一間投資控股公司。本公司及其附
 and its subsidiaries (collectively “the Group”) are principally       屬 公 司（統 稱「本 集 團」）主 要 從 事 設 計、 研
 engaged in the business of designing, researching and developing,     究與開發、生產及銷售光學及其相關產品與

      participants at the measurement date, regardless of whether that               的價格，不論該價格是否可直接觀察到或採

      technique. In estimating the fair value of an asset or a liability,            公允值時，倘市場參與者可能考慮資產或負
      the Group takes into account the characteristics of the asset or               債的特色，則本集團將於計量日期為資產或
      liability if market participants would take those characteristics into         負債定價時考慮有關特色。於綜合財務報表
      account when pricing the asset or liability at the measurement                 內計量及 ╱ 或披露的公允值按此基準釐定，

      (iii) Credit-impaired financial assets                                         (iii) 信貸減值的金融資產


          A financial asset is credit-impaired when one or more events                 當一件或多件對一項金融資產估計未來
          of default that have a detrimental impact on the estimated                   現金流量產生不利影響的違約事件發生
          future cash flows of that financial asset have occurred.                     時，該金融資產則出現信貸減值。有關
          Evidence that a financial asset is credit-impaired includes                  金融資產出現信貸減值的證據包括有關
          observable data about the following events:                                  以下事項的可觀察數據：


          (a) significant financial difficulty of the issuer or the borrower;          (a) 發行人或借款人出現重大財政困難；


          (b) a breach of contract, such as a default or past due event;               (b) 不履行債務或逾期支付等違約行為；


          (c) the lender(s) of the borrower, for economic or contractual               (c) 借款人的貸款人因有關借款人財務
               reasons relating to the borrower’s financial difficulty,                   困 難 的 經 濟 或 合 約 原 因， 給 予 借 款
               having granted to the borrower a concession(s) that the                    人在一般情況下不會考慮的優惠安
               lender(s) would not otherwise consider;                                    排；


          (d) it is becoming probable that the borrower will enter                     (d) 借 款 人 可 能 破 產 或 面 臨 財 務 重 組；
               bankruptcy or other financial reorganisation; or                           或


          (e) the disappearance of an active market for that financial                 (e) 該金融資產的活躍市場因財務困難
               asset because of financial difficulties.                                   而消失。

 (iv) Write-off policy                                                     (iv) 撇銷政策


     The Group writes off a financial asset when there is information         倘有資料顯示交易對手處於嚴重財務困
     indicating that the counterparty is in severe financial difficulty       難及無實際期望可收回欠款，本集團則
     and there is no realistic prospect of recovery, for example,             撇 銷 該 金 融 資 產（例 如 於 交 易 對 手 被 清
     when the counterparty has been placed under liquidation or               盤或進入破產程序時）。金融資產撇銷仍
     has entered into bankruptcy proceedings. Financial assets                受限於本集團收回欠款程序下的執行活
     written off may still be subject to enforcement activities               動，且在適當情況下將參考法律意見。
     under the Group’s recovery procedures, taking into account               撇銷構成一項終止確認事項，任何其後
     legal advice where appropriate. A write-off constitutes a                收回的欠款於損益內確認。
     derecognition event. Any subsequent recoveries are
     recognised in profit or loss.


 (v) Measurement and recognition of ECL                                    (v) 預期信貸虧損的計量及確認


     The measurement of ECL is a function of the probability                  計量預期信貸虧損時，會綜合考慮違約
     of default, loss given default (i.e. the magnitude of the                可能性、違約損失率（即發生違約時的損
     loss if there is a default) and the exposure at default. The             失程度）及違約風險承擔。違約可能性及
     assessment of the probability of default and loss given default          違約損失率的評定乃基於根據前瞻性資
     is based on historical data adjusted by forward-looking                  料作出調整的歷史數據。預期信貸虧損
     information. Estimation of ECL reflects an unbiased and                  的估算乃公正及概率加權的數額，其按
     probability-weighted amount that is determined with the                  相應違約風險的權重釐定。
     respective risks of default occurring as the weights.


     Generally, the ECL is the difference between all contractual             一般而言，預期信貸虧損估計為根據合
     cash flows that are due to the Group in accordance with the              約應付本集團的所有合約現金流量與本
     contract and the cash flows that the Group expects to receive,           集團預期將收取的全部現金流量之間的
     discounted at the effective interest rate determined at initial          差額，並按初步確認時釐定的實際利率
     recognition.                                                             貼現。

  Segment assets and liabilities                                            分部資產及負債

  The accounting policies of the operating segments are the same            營運分部的會計政策與附註3所述的本集團
  as the Group’s accounting policies described in Note 3. Segment           會計政策相同。分部溢利指由各分部所賺取
  profit represents the profit earned by each segment without               的溢利，但並無攤分中央行政成本（包括董
  allocation of central administration costs including directors’           事薪金、其他收益、其他收益或虧損、分佔
  salaries, other income, other gains or losses, share of results of        聯營公司的業績及融資成本）。營運分部間存
  associates and finance costs. There were asymmetrical allocations         在不對稱分配，這是由於本集團在分配利息
  to operating segments because the Group allocates interest                收入、政府補助金、折舊及攤銷以及出售物
  income, government grants, depreciation and amortisation and              業、機器及設備收益或虧損至各分部時，並
  gain or loss on disposal of property, plant and equipment to each         未向各分部分配相關銀行結餘、遞延收入、
  segment without allocating the related bank balances, deferred            物業、機器及設備以及無形資產。此乃向董
  income, property, plant and equipment and intangible assets to            事會報告以作資源分配及表現評估的基準。
  those segments. This is the measure reported to the Board of
  Directors for the purposes of resource allocation and performance
  assessment.

  Inter-segment sales are charged at prevailing market rates.               分部間銷售按現行市價入賬。

36. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                              36. 資本風險管理
  The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in the Group      本集團會管理資本，維持最有利的債務及權
  will be able to continue as a going concern while maximising the        益結構，以確保本集團轄下公司能夠持續經
  return to shareholders through the optimisation of the debt and         營，盡量提高股東的回報。本集團的整體策
  equity balance. The Group’s overall strategy remains unchanged          略與去年相同。
  from prior year.

  The capital structure of the Group consists of net debt, which          本集團的資本架構由負債淨額（包括於附註
  includes the bank borrowings disclosed in Note 32 and bonds             32中披露的銀行借貸及於附註34中披露的應
  payables disclosed in Note 34, net of cash and cash equivalents         付債券（扣除現金及現金等值項目））及本公
  and equity attributable to owners of the Company, comprising            司股東應佔權益（包括已發行股本、保留溢
  issued share capital, retained profits and other reserves.              利及其他儲備）組成。

  The directors of the Company review the capital structure on a          本公司董事每半年檢討一次資本架構。作為
  semi-annual basis. As part of this review, the directors of the         檢討的一部分，本公司董事考慮資本成本及
  Company consider the cost of capital and the risks associates with      各 類 資 本 相 關 風 險。 根 據 本 公 司 董 事 的 建
  each class of capital. Based on recommendations of the directors        議，本集團將透過支付股息、發行新股及股
  of the Company, the Group will balance its overall capital structure    份購回以及發行新債或償還現有債務來平衡
  through the payment of dividends, new share issues and share            其整體資本架構。
  buy-backs as well as the issue of new debts or the repayment of
  existing debts.

    PERIOD

  (a) On 10 January 2019, the Company, through its wholly-owned         (a) 於 二 零 一 九 年 一 月 十 日， 本 公 司 透 過
     subsidiaries, Ningbo Sunny Opotech Company Limited and                寧 波 舜 宇 光 電 信 息 有 限 公 司 及Summit
     Summit Optical Investment Limited, jointly established a new          Optical Technology Limited（皆為本公
     subsidiary in Indian named Sunny Opotech India Private                司之全資附屬公司）共同在印度成立名為
     Limited to meet the customer’s demand in the Indian market.           Sunny Opotech India Private Limited的
                                                                           新附屬公司，以滿足印度市場的客戶需
                                                                           求。


  (b) On 21 January 2019, the Company, through its wholly-owned         (b) 於二零一九年一月二十一日，本公司透
     subsidiary, Zhejiang Sunny Optics Company Limited, acquired           過浙江舜宇光學有限公司（本公司之全資
     certain equity interests in a Japanese company which is               附屬公司）收購一家日本公司的若干股
